Document: Practice Direction 45 – Table of Fixed Costs (2024)
Part 3 of 5
==================================================
If Parties reach a settlement prior to the claimant issuing proceedings under Part 7

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] (1) Where damages are not more than £5,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £ Nil

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] The greater of £681 or £124 + an amount equivalent to 20% of the damages

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £1,136 + an amount equivalent to 17.5% of the damages

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] In each case—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £2,684 + an amount equivalent to 15% of the damages + £526 per extra defendant

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] (2) Where damages are more than £5,000, but not more than £10,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £ Nil

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £1,342 + an amount equivalent to 15% of damages over £5,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £2,271 + an amount equivalent to 12.5% of damages over £5,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] (3) Where damages are more than £10,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £599

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £2,374 + an amount equivalent to 10% of damages over £10,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £3,097 + an amount equivalent to 10% of damages over £10,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] B. If proceedings are issued under Part 7, but the case settles or is discontinued before trial

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] (1) On or after the date that the court issues the claim, but before the date that the court allocates the claim under Part 26

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £2,168

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £1,445 + an amount equivalent to 20% of the damages

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £3,303 + an amount equivalent to 20% of the damages

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £3,097 + an amount equivalent to 40% of the damages + £785 per extra defendant

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] (2) On or after the date that the court allocates the claim under Part 26, but before the date that the court lists the claim for trial

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £2,581

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £2,374 + an amount equivalent to 20% of the damages

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £4,129 + an amount equivalent to 25% of the damages

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £6,607 + an amount equivalent to 40% of the damages + £785 per extra defendant

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] (3)On or after the date that the court lists the claim for trial but before trial

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £3,923

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £3,303 + an amount equivalent to 20% of the damages

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £5,265 + an amount equivalent to 30% of the damages

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £8,155 + an amount equivalent to 40% of the damages + £785 per extra defendant

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] C. If the claim is disposed of at trial

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £3,923

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £3,303 + an amount equivalent to 20% of the damages agreed or awarded

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £5,265 + an amount equivalent to 30% of the damages agreed or awarded

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £8,155 + an amount equivalent to 40% of the damages agreed or awarded +  £785 per extra defendant

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] D. Trial advocacy fees

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] (1) Where the value of the claim is not more than £3,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] £619

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] (5) Where the claim is listed for trial, but is removed from the list or settled—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 4] on the day of trial; or                                        not more than 1 day before the date listed for trial

## 100% of the applicable trial advocacy fee

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 100% of the applicable trial advocacy fee] (6) Where the claim is listed for trial, but is removed from the list or settled more than 1 day, but not more than 2 days, before the date listed for trial

## 75% of the applicable trial advocacy fee”. ## Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] In calculating the number of days, rule 2.8(2) shall not apply and any advocacy fee is to be computed by reference to the following examples. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] Examples

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] (1) A claim allocated to the fast track is settled not more than 1 day before the date listed for trial. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] The trial date is Monday 23 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] Settlement not more than 1 day before the date listed for trial, means that the claim was settled on or after Friday 20 October, but before Monday 23 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] (2) A claim allocated to the fast track is removed from the list not more than 1 day before the date listed for trial. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] The trial date is Thursday 26 October

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] Removal from the list not more than 1 day before the date listed for trial, means that the claim was removed from the list on Wednesday 25 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] (3) A claim allocated to the fast track is settled more than 1 day, but not more than 2 days, before the date listed for trial. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] (a) The trial date is Monday 23 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] Settlement more than 1 day, but not more than 2 days, before the date listed for trial, means that the claim was settled on Thursday 19 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] (b) The trial date is Thursday 26 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > Trial advocacy fees: Table 12(5) and (6)] Settlement more than 1 day, but not more than 2 days, before the date listed for trial, means that the claim was settled on Tuesday 24 October. ## TABLE 13: rule 45.46 – specialist legal advice

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > TABLE 13: rule 45.46 – specialist legal advice] A. Providing post-issue advice in writing or in conference | £1,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > TABLE 13: rule 45.46 – specialist legal advice] B. Drafting a statement of case | £500

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > TABLE 13: rule 45.46 – specialist legal advice] A. Providing post-issue advice in writing or in conference

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > TABLE 13: rule 45.46 – specialist legal advice] £1,000

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > TABLE 13: rule 45.46 – specialist legal advice] B.
